entities.name: Manuel Suárez y Suárez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel Suárez y Suárez was a Spanish immigrant to Mexico who became a successful entrepreneur and patron of the arts. He is known for the Casino de la Selva in Cuernavaca, the Hotel de México, and the adjacent Polyforum Cultural Siqueiros.
